journey.name: wear activity list
journey.description:
The Activity page, after Receive, lists the newest payments with a direction icon, the amount and how long ago; a tap opens the detail with the amount, the fee of a send, the time and the status. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet on the local ./spark stack after receive-paid.xml and send-deeplink-bolt11.xml, so the newest payment is the 1 000 sat send, see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack, on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped. Gestures are written for the 454 px screen.

actions.action: Swipe the pager left to Receive: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Wait up to 5 s until "WatchReceiveOpen" is listed
Swipe the pager left to Activity: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Wait up to 10 s until "WatchActivityItem-0" is listed
Verify "WatchActivityItem-0" shows a relative time such as "1 min. ago"
Swipe to dismiss from the left edge: `adb shell input swipe 20 227 400 227 300`
